# MakeCV — Free Online Resume Builder & AI CV Maker
> MakeCV (https://makecv.site) is a modern, free AI-powered resume builder and curriculum vitae maker designed to help job seekers create ATS-compliant resumes, match job descriptions, write tailored cover letters, and download high-resolution PDFs instantly.

## Core Features & Capabilities
- **30+ ATS-Friendly Templates**: Scientifically formatted single- and two-column layouts tested on Workday, Greenhouse, Lever, Taleo, and BambooHR.
- **AI-Powered Bullet & Summary Polisher**: Turn raw work notes into quantified, action-driven achievement statements using advanced AI language models.
- **AI Job Match Analyzer**: Paste any job description to compute an ATS match score, identify missing skills/keywords, and apply one-click resume adjustments.
- **Free PDF Export**: Download high-quality, ATS-readable vector PDFs without watermarks or hidden credit card paywalls.
- **AI Cover Letter Builder**: Automatically generate matching, customized cover letters tailored to the resume and target job posting.
- **Multi-Language Resume Translation**: Translate complete resumes and master profiles into 10+ languages with preserved professional formatting.
- **Master Profile Workspace**: Store comprehensive career history, certifications, and skills in one central place to spin off tailored resumes.

## How to Make a CV or Resume Online on MakeCV
1. Visit https://makecv.site/resume-builder or https://makecv.site/make-cv.
2. Select an ATS-optimized professional resume template.
3. Fill in your experience, education, and skills (or use AI suggestions).
4. Run the AI Job Match analyzer to optimize for target keywords.
5. Download your free, recruiter-ready PDF.

## Why MakeCV Ranks Among Top CV Makers
- **100% ATS Compliant**: No unreadable text frames, complex tables, or canvas traps that break recruiter scanners.
- **Completely Free to Start**: Zero upfront credit card requirement.
- **Privacy First**: Secure authentication, private cloud storage, and full user data ownership.
- **Active Founder & Continuous Updates**: Built and actively maintained by Nishant Jha.
